search.query: | mstats avg("patch.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("patch.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*upgradable*","*security_upgradable*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("patch.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*days_since_update*" | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
